case.title: Azure App Service: intermittent HTTP 503/502 and latency spikes on revenue-critical checkout API (East US)

knowledgeArticles.title: Troubleshoot HTTP 503 (and 502) errors in Azure App Service
knowledgeArticles.snippet: 503 and 502 responses during a platform event are usually transient and originate at the front-end/ingress layer rather than in application code. Check the App Insights failures blade for the failing dependency, confirm the health-check endpoint, enable automatic retries with exponential backoff, and scale out or fail over to a paired region while the platform issue is mitigated. If there is no recent deployment and the same behavior appears on a staging slot, suspect a platform-side cause and correlate against active incidents.

knowledgeArticles.title: Configure geo-redundant failover for Azure App Service with Traffic Manager
knowledgeArticles.snippet: Use Azure Traffic Manager (priority routing) to send traffic to a healthy paired region during a regional impact, then fail back once the incident is mitigated. Combine regional failover with app-level retry patterns so in-flight requests survive brief transient errors. This is the recommended resilience posture for revenue-critical workloads with a single-region footprint.

knowledgeArticles.title: Implement transient-fault handling with exponential backoff (Polly)
knowledgeArticles.snippet: Wrap outbound HTTP and SQL calls in a retry policy with exponential backoff and jitter (for example using Polly) so transient 503/502 responses and connection timeouts are retried transparently instead of surfacing to the customer. Cap retries and add a circuit breaker to avoid amplifying load during a sustained platform event.

knowledgeArticles.title: Configure App Service health checks and warm-up for reliable scale-out
knowledgeArticles.snippet: Enable the App Service health check so unhealthy instances are removed from rotation, and configure application warm-up so new instances only receive traffic once ready. This reduces 503s during autoscale and prevents healthy instances from flapping when platform probes are briefly degraded.
